summary: Access request: restricted Compliance Evidence (SOC 2 / security artifacts) folder for Sales/SE (Aurora Financial deal)
description:
Requestor(s):
- Avery Johnson (AE)
- Colin O'Donnell (Solutions Engineering)

Request:
Grant temporary read-only access to the restricted Compliance Evidence storage ("GRC Evidence Vault" / SOC 2 report and supporting artifacts) to support an in-flight enterprise security review.

Business justification:
Aurora Financial has requested SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence under NDA as part of procurement. Deal timeline is expedited; Sales/SE needs access to pull the latest, approved artifacts and ensure we do not send outdated versions.

Requested resources:
- Google Drive shared drive folder: "Security & Compliance Evidence (Restricted)" (a.k.a. "GRC Evidence Vault")
- Subfolder(s): "SOC 2 Type II" + "Security Program Overview" (customer-facing artifacts only)

Access level requested:
- Read-only
- Time-bound (14 days)

Notes / constraints:
- Access should be limited to the customer-facing evidence set only (no internal audit workpapers).
- Evidence must only be shared with customer after confirming NDA is in place per the SOC 2 Customer Evidence Request Playbook.
- Do not upload evidence to third-party portals unless explicitly approved by GRC + Legal.

Approvals required (per policy):
- GRC approval: Olga Petrov (primary), Daniel Carter (backup)
- Security escalation if urgent: Dr. Aisha Rahman

Reference:
- Confluence: "SOC 2 customer evidence request playbook" (intake + NDA + approved artifact list)
- GRC tracking: "evidence-request-triage-queue" (ensure request is logged before sharing)

Requested completion target:
- Within 1 business day (Aurora Financial security review follow-up scheduled for next week).
